lessons.title: Turn a vague idea into a testable specification.
lessons.content: Describe the app’s users, required screens, programming languages, external services, and what must happen when something fails. Include how you would verify the result.
lessons.example: Create a web app with login, an editable dashboard, a PostgreSQL database and automated tests.

lessons.title: Describe the sound, not just the genre.
lessons.content: Specify the rhythm, instrumentation, tempo feel, arrangement, and any parts that must stand out. Distinguish a purely instrumental result from one that needs vocals.
lessons.example: I want an actionable, editable music deliverable and a way to review the result.

lessons.title: Choose what a poem should make a reader experience.
lessons.content: Define the emotional shift, imagery, voice, stanza structure and whether rhythm, rhyme or free verse matters more than a rigid syllable count.
lessons.example: I want an actionable, editable poetry deliverable and a way to review the result.

lessons.title: Begin with the audience and a concrete desired action.
lessons.content: Identify who you are trying to persuade, what they currently believe, what evidence they trust and one strong objection your argument must answer.
lessons.example: I want an actionable, editable persuasive-writing deliverable and a way to review the result.

lessons.title: Frame a falsifiable research question.
lessons.content: Specify what counts as a credible source, geographic and date limits, potential counterevidence and the exact evidence required to support each claim.
lessons.example: I want an actionable, editable research deliverable and a way to review the result.

lessons.title: State the policy objective before drafting statutory language.
lessons.content: Choose the legal jurisdiction, existing statutes to amend, defined terms, enforcement mechanism, implementation timing and expected stakeholders.
lessons.example: I want an actionable, editable legislation deliverable and a way to review the result.

lessons.title: Describe composition with measurable details.
lessons.content: Specify subject, framing, camera or perspective, light, palette, references and the region to edit or preserve. Keep any embedded text short and explicit.
lessons.example: I want an actionable, editable image deliverable and a way to review the result.

lessons.title: Plan deliverables before generating shots.
lessons.content: Describe duration, aspect ratio, script, shot count, subject consistency, continuity references, soundtrack and final export format.
lessons.example: I want an actionable, editable video deliverable and a way to review the result.

lessons.title: Write for listening rather than only reading.
lessons.content: Specify audience, delivery pace, language, pronunciation, transcript or caption needs and rights to use any distinctive voice.
lessons.example: I want an actionable, editable voice deliverable and a way to review the result.

lessons.title: Define the question and data quality rules first.
lessons.content: Describe data sources, units, missing values, outlier treatment, transformations, chart conventions and how to reproduce the analysis.
lessons.example: I want an actionable, editable data deliverable and a way to review the result.

lessons.title: Start with inputs, decisions, approvals and final outputs.
lessons.content: Identify each automated step, its prerequisites, cost limit, failure handling and exactly which consequential actions require human approval.
lessons.example: I want an actionable, editable workflow deliverable and a way to review the result.
